title: Refusal-overlap predictor: does a steering vector's danger reduce to its angle with the refusal direction?

original_idea.body: Test whether cosine with refusal direction predicts a steering vector's harmful-compliance increase via regression. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a cheap pre-deployment danger predictor for steering vectors has clear concrete safety value (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Generate vectors, cosine, regression; clear methodology, statistics-friendly, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (regression of overlap vs danger + residuals), few dependencies (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly, reproducible safety-tooling work on open models (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Overlap-danger correlation reported; turning it into a tested predictor across diverse vectors may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Correlation is reported; validating it as a predictor across vector types may be open.
